title: Rust: Traits and Generics
description: Define and implement traits, and use generics with trait bounds in Rust.

steps.title: Define a Trait
steps.description: Define a trait `Area` with a method `area(&self) -> f64`. Implement it for `Circle` (from a radius) and `Rectangle` (width, height). Print their areas.
hints: `impl Area for Circle { fn area(&self) -> f64 { 3.14159 * self.r * self.r } }`
Create structs first, then implement the trait.

verification.failureMessage: Print areas of Circle(5) and Rectangle(4, 5).

steps.title: Default Trait Methods
steps.description: Define a trait `Greeter` with a default method `greet(&self) -> String` that returns `"Hello!"`. Implement for a `Person` struct (override) and a `Robot` struct (use default).
hints: Override: `impl Greeter for Person { fn greet(&self) -> String { format!("Hi, I'm {}", self.name) } }`

verification.failureMessage: Print greet() from both Person and Robot.

steps.title: Generic Function with Trait Bound
steps.description: Write a generic function `print_area<T: Area>(shape: T)` that prints the area of any type implementing Area. Call with a Circle and a Rectangle.
hints: The `<T: Area>` syntax constrains T to types that implement Area.
This is polymorphism at compile time (monomorphization).

verification.successMessage: Generic function with trait bound works!
verification.failureMessage: Call print_area with a Circle and Rectangle.

steps.title: Derive Traits
steps.description: Create a struct `Point { x: i32, y: i32 }` and derive `Debug`, `Clone`, `Copy`, `PartialEq`. Demonstrate each: print with {:?}, clone, compare.

verification.failureMessage: Demonstrate Debug, Clone, and PartialEq on Point.

steps.title: Trait as Return Type (impl Trait)
steps.description: Write a function `make_circle(r: f64) -> impl Area` that returns something implementing Area (a Circle). Call and print its area.
hints: `fn make_circle(r: f64) -> impl Area { Circle { r } }`
`impl Trait` in return position lets you return a concrete type.
The caller can only use methods from the `Area` trait.

verification.failureMessage: Return a Circle as impl Area and print its area.
